phase_prompt.prompt_block: Full body shot of Mighbari, a master ancient-tech engineer. Deep umber skin with metallic scarification on jaw. He wears heavy charcoal linen robes under a leather and oxidized bronze industrial apron. Articulated basalt plates on shoulders. Standing in a dimly lit, cavernous temple-factory. Cinematic lighting, volumetric atmosphere, 8k resolution, photorealistic, textures of rough stone and cold metal.
